items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve heard him play with you at the Plaza... He can sit there and just... just play gloriously.

ctx.x: Especially when you start pedaling, have your bass singer pedal [Freeman hums]. That music can go anywhere. You can use all the twelve tones, and it [?] up your creativity, because it’s limitless. You can go anywhere, to the end of the world and back. So, when I got into that part of it, I said, oh my goodness, there’s so much to get together here. So I started really trying to find piano players and things that thought on the same lines that I did. That’s when I run into Chris Anderson. He taught me . . .
